resources.name: Texas Adult Protective Services (APS)
resources.description: Get help if someone is hurting you, taking your money, or not caring for you. APS looks into abuse, neglect, or money harm for people age 65 and older, or adults with disabilities. They can send a worker to talk with you and help make a safety plan. They may work with police, doctors, and local helpers. You can call for yourself or someone can call for you. You do not have to give your name if you are scared.
resources.availability_status: 24/7 hotline — call any time to report abuse or money harm

resources.name: Texas Legal Services Center – Crime Victims and Elder Financial Safety
resources.description: Get free legal help if someone misused your money, property, or identity. Help is for older adults and crime victims with low income in Texas. Lawyers can help with money harm, scams, power of attorney problems, and safety plans. They can explain your rights in simple words. They may help with court papers and talking to banks or police. You can call from home and do not need to travel.
resources.address: 1920 East Riverside Drive, Suite A-120, Austin, TX 78741
resources.availability_status: Call for current intake hours and to see if you qualify

resources.name: Austin Police Department – Elder Abuse Unit (via 3-1-1 or 9-1-1)

resources.availability_status: Emergency help 24/7 through 9-1-1; non-emergency line also 24/7
